extraction_notes: Target identity retained exactly from job metadata: SI2301A, UMW Youtai Semiconductor Co Ltd, p-channel MOSFET.

The supplied six-page PDF title is UMW SI2301A; the document footer identifies UTD Semiconductor Co.,Limited and shows Nov.2024. The manufacturer field remains the requested UMW Youtai Semiconductor Co Ltd identity.
P-channel electrical quantities retain the signed values printed in the datasheet. Capacitances and resistance remain positive SI quantities.
Both typical and maximum RDS(ON) values are transcribed for both published VGS/ID conditions. Maximum values are inclusive and include the datasheet pulse-test footnote.

The p. 2 Dynamic table explicitly labels Ciss = 405 pF, Coss = 75 pF, and Crss = 55 pF. Its merged condition cell applies VDS = -10 V, VGS = 0 V, and f = 1 MHz to all three entries; these are stored with SI prefixes converted to farads as 4.05e-10 F, 7.5e-11 F, and 5.5e-11 F respectively.

The catalog hint of Crss = 10 pF at 10 V was not forced into the extraction: the supplied SI2301A PDF directly prints Crss = 55 pF in the p. 2 table under the shared VDS = -10 V, VGS = 0 V, f = 1 MHz condition, so the PDF value is the authoritative direct evidence.
Direct compact readings were extracted from the supplied typical output and capacitance plots on p. 3. No transfer-characteristic plot is present, and no points were invented or interpolated.
extraction.omission_reason: No transfer-characteristic plot is present in the supplied PDF; output and capacitance curves were available and extracted from p. 3.
